mappings.title: Input Validation
mappings.description: Validate all input from untrusted sources
mappings.implementation: Server-side validation of all user inputs, query parameters, headers, and file uploads. Reject malformed data before processing.
mappings.evidence: All API routes validate payload against Zod/Joi schemas before database operations

mappings.title: Output Encoding
mappings.description: Encode all output based on context
mappings.implementation: Contextual encoding for HTML, JavaScript, CSS, and URL output. Use maintained encoding library.
mappings.evidence: src/components/common/encoding-utils.ts provides HTML, JS, CSS, and URL encoding helpers

mappings.title: Authentication Controls
mappings.description: Strong authentication with appropriate factors
mappings.implementation: Prefer established identity integration; phishing-resistant auth for privileged roles; WebAuthn validation per OWASP Passkey Cheat Sheet
mappings.evidence: src/components/auth/AuthProvider.tsx handles authentication; WebAuthn challenge-response validation implemented

mappings.title: Session Management
mappings.description: Secure session handling throughout user interaction
mappings.implementation: Session rotation on password change; Secure HttpOnly cookies; SameSite behavior; explicit idle/absolute expiry; session revocation on logout
mappings.evidence: src/lib/session.ts manages session cookies with HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite flags

mappings.title: Access Control
mappings.description: Deny-by-default access permissions
mappings.implementation: Server-side roles and object ownership; public clients receive no administrative credentials; cross-user read/write tests fail closed
mappings.evidence: src/lib/authorization.ts implements deny-by-default role checks

mappings.title: Cryptographic Storage
mappings.description: Protect stored data with strong cryptography
mappings.implementation: Encryption at rest for sensitive data; hashed passwords with Argon2id; no plaintext secrets in source
mappings.evidence: Convex database uses encrypted storage; passwords hashed with Argon2id

mappings.title: Error Handling and Logging
mappings.description: Handle errors gracefully without leaking sensitive information
mappings.implementation: Error boundaries in React; structured logging without secrets; user-facing errors generic; internal errors logged with correlation IDs
mappings.evidence: src/components/error/ErrorBoundary.tsx; src/lib/logger.ts

mappings.title: Auditing
mappings.description: Maintain audit logs of security-relevant events
mappings.implementation: Log authentication anomalies, authorization denials, admin changes, score edits; no submitted secrets in logs; tabletop exercises for incident response
mappings.evidence: T21: Implement privacy-aware monitoring and incident response

mappings.title: Configuration Management
mappings.description: Secure configuration with change management
mappings.implementation: Environment variables for secrets; no hardcoded credentials; configuration review on deployment; feature flags for new capabilities
mappings.evidence: dotenv environment variables; feature flags in src/feature-flags.ts

mappings.title: Client-Side Security
mappings.description: Protect against client-side attacks
mappings.implementation: CSP in report-only mode; XSS sanitization; DOM-based XSS prevention; no eval(); sanitize rich text and Markdown
mappings.evidence: src/lib/csp.ts; src/components/blocks/NewsletterBlock.tsx sanitization

mappings.title: Data Protection
mappings.description: Encrypt and protect data in transit and at rest
mappings.implementation: HTTPS everywhere; Secure HttpOnly cookies; encrypted Convex database; no mixed content
mappings.evidence: server.ts enforces HTTPS redirects; Convex provides encrypted storage

mappings.title: Communication Security
mappings.description: Protect data in transit
mappings.implementation: TLS 1.2+ for all connections; HSTS after subdomain review; no legacy protocols; certificate pinning not required for public content
mappings.evidence: server.ts redirects HTTP to HTTPS; nginx.conf has HSTS configuration

mappings.title: Time and State
mappings.description: Proper handling of time and state
mappings.implementation: Session expiry; absolute idle/active timeout; nonce validation for WebAuthn; challenge expiration; one-time use validation
mappings.evidence: src/lib/session.ts session expiry; WebAuthn challenge validation in AuthProvider.tsx

mappings.title: Code Quality
mappings.description: Maintain high code quality standards
mappings.implementation: ESLint configuration; TypeScript strict mode; unit tests; integration tests; CI quality gates; SBOM generation
mappings.evidence: eslint.config.js; package.json test scripts; CI pipeline

mappings.title: System Hardening
mappings.description: Harden system configuration and reduce attack surface
mappings.implementation: Remove unused dependencies; minimal CSP directives; disable unnecessary HTTP methods; nginx security headers; dependency pinning
mappings.evidence: nginx.conf security headers; package.json locked dependencies; scripts/ check-convex-deploy-key.ts

mappings.title: Client-Side Injection
mappings.description: Prevent injection of malicious content into client execution
mappings.implementation: No user-controlled innerHTML; sanitize all rich text; SVG stripping; Markdown with safe mode only; CSP enforcement
mappings.evidence: src/lib/sanitization.ts strips SVG, prevents innerHTML injection

mappings.title: Authentication Credentials
mappings.description: Protect authentication credentials throughout their lifecycle
mappings.implementation: Never store passwords; session cookies HttpOnly Secure; credential changes require recent authentication; notify on credential changes
mappings.evidence: AuthProvider.tsx credential change flow; session rotation on password change

mappings.title: Session Fixation
mappings.description: Prevent session fixation attacks
mappings.implementation: Regenerate session ID after authentication; rotate session cookie on privilege changes; invalidate on logout
mappings.evidence: src/lib/session.ts session regeneration after auth

mappings.title: Password Management
mappings.description: Secure password storage and management
mappings.implementation: Argon2id for password hashing; no password reuse enforcement (prefer education); password change flow with recent authentication requirement
mappings.evidence: Convex schema uses Argon2id; no password complexity enforcement without user education

mappings.title: Account Enumeration
mappings.description: Prevent user account enumeration
mappings.implementation: Generic error messages on auth failure; constant-time response handling; captcha on repeated failures; no username exposure in error paths
mappings.evidence: AuthProvider.tsx generic login failure messages; rate limiting on auth attempts

notes: L2 alignment is a target, not certification. See threat-model.md for full threat model context.
